name: Azuremyst Isle: a ghost released in Tides' Hollow reaches a Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies in Tides' Hollow (zone 3569, at the Wrathscale Naga spawn (-4874.8,-11600.8,6.4)) releases at the nearest graveyard of Azuremyst Isle (3524), graveyard 923 (-4312.78,-12441,17.1903), instead of the default Westfall graveyard. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Azuremyst graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
